(rule!
  (grid-from-fn h w
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
        (if (and (= v 0)
                 (or
                   (and (< (+ c 2) w)
                        (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 6)
                        (= (cell-at g r (+ c 2)) 6))
                   (and (>= (- c 2) 0)
                        (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 6)
                        (= (cell-at g r (- c 2)) 6))))
            8
            v)))))

(rule!
  (grid-from-fn h w
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
        (if (and (= v 0)
                 (or
                   (and (< (+ c 2) w)
                        (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 6)
                        (= (cell-at g r (+ c 2)) 6))
                   (and (>= (- c 2) 0)
                        (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 6)
                        (= (cell-at g r (- c 2)) 6))))
            8
            v)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((new-caps
           (for*/list ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)]
                       #:when (and (= (cell-at g r c) 0)
                   (or (and (< (+ c 2) w)
                            (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 6)
                            (= (cell-at g r (+ c 2)) 6))
                       (and (>= (- c 2) 0)
                            (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 6)
                            (= (cell-at g r (- c 2)) 6)))))
             (list r c)))
         (capped
           (grid-from-fn h w
             (lambda (r c)
               (if (member (list r c) new-caps) 8 (cell-at g r c)))))
         (old-cyan
           (for*/list ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)]
                       #:when (= (cell-at g r c) 8))
             (list r c)))
         (anchors new-caps)
         (bridges
           (apply append
             (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
               (let ((rows (sort (map first
                                     (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) c)) anchors)) <)))
                 (apply append
                   (for/list ([i (in-range (max 0 (- (length rows) 1)))])
                     (let ((a (list-ref rows i)) (b (list-ref rows (+ i 1))))
                       (if (for/and ([r (in-range (+ a 1) b)])
                             (= (cell-at capped r c) 0))
                           (for/list ([r (in-range (+ a 1) b)]) (list r c))
                           '())))))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (member (list r c) bridges) 8 (cell-at capped r c))))))
